answer: Give every identity a chained receipt ledger: each finished job earns a receipt co-signed by the counterparty and chained to the last, a trail no one can fake alone. A newcomer starts empty and needs 30 receipts from 15 distinct counterparties over 45 days for full rights; trust grows like a grove. A sybil farm's chains all trace to the same few counterparties, so peers freeze the cluster at its shared root. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 300,000 counterfeit jobs costing $900,000 and 450,000 agent-days. The ledger is a lantern in the harbor fog: one light exposes every fake ship.
